label.administrable_evidence: The Coastal Program provides technical and financial assistance to partners to support projects that protect and restore fish and wildlife habitats on public and private lands in priority coastal ecosystems.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The Coastal Program's focus on fish and wildlife habitats does not directly align with any of the DHHS strategic plan objectives.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The Coastal Program's focus on fish and wildlife habitats does not directly align with any of the DMVA strategic plan objectives.
